Notes, `EvolutionSession.Evolve`, saving to a new output folder and the solved check are wired in `MainMenu`, `TargetCommands` and `PartCommands`; pilot then pick by name in three places; benchmark and select in two (only the menu saves the tables); library loading in `CommandOptions.PartLibrary` and `CompositionParts.Load`; part loading in `ExportCommands` and `VerifyCommand`; and the menu and command line pass different hardware and robustness settings to evolve-parts.
We want an `Application` namespace with one service per run, taking settings and returning typed results, and `Settings`, the sessions and `RunAdvisor` moved there from `Cli`.

Its responsibilities are:
* Services: evolve, compile, evolve-parts, compose, reach, benchmark, verify, export
* One part loader and one library loader returning typed errors
* One seeded random policy, stated once
* `Settings` and its defaults out of `Cli`, so tests outside the CLI do not depend on it
* The evolve-parts settings mismatch between menu and command line resolved, with the choice stated in the pull request

A service should never write to the console, and should report progress through a callback, because tests and the menu need the result without parsing output.
Where the menu and the command line behave differently today, the service should follow the command line and the pull request should list each difference, because the command line is what benchmarks ran.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Cli/` (all sessions, `Settings.cs`, `RunAdvisor.cs`, `RunOutput.cs`, `Catalog.cs`, `CompositionParts.cs`, `CommandOptions.cs`, `TargetCommands.cs`, `PartCommands.cs`, `ExportCommands.cs`, `VerifyCommand.cs`, `MainMenu.cs`).

Done when:
- [ ] Each run flow has one implementation, called by the menu and the command line
- [ ] No class outside `Cli` depends on `Cli`
- [ ] Golden runs unchanged; `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "Using the GUI"
